number of children in the family
outcome: father involvement in the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 80 biological fathers of infants in a 97-bed neonatal intensive care unit in the southern USA
finding: Fathers who were more involved in the neonatal intensive care unit were younger, married or living with the mother, performed kangaroo care, or were fathers of multiple gestations.
mod_finding: Fathers who had attended the delivery were more likely to bathe their infants than those who had not attended the delivery.
